title: Discovering Cross-Language Reasoning Invariance in LLMs with Geometry-Invariant Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2608.23809v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multilingual language models can solve the same mathematical problem in different languages, but it remains unclear whether they rely on shared features or on language-specific computations that only produce similar outputs. We study this question in five models from four families using the Multilingual Grade School Math (MGSM) dataset, with problems solved in English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, and Chinese, retaining problems with valid reasoning traces in all six languages and replaying those traces through the model to record representations at multiple layers. For each model, we first use Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to identify layers with cross-language alignment. At each selected layer, we train two sparse autoencoders (SAE): a baseline reconstruction-only model and a contrastive variant introduced in this work, the Geometry-Invariant SAE (GI-SAE). GI-SAE supplements the reconstruction loss with an Information Noise-Co

translated_title: 发现大语言模型中基于几何不变稀疏自编码器的跨语言推理不变性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23809v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：多语言语言模型可以用不同语言解决相同的数学问题，但仍不清楚它们是依赖共享特征，还是依赖仅产生相似输出的语言特定计算。我们使用多语言小学数学（MGSM）数据集，在四个家族的五个模型中研究此问题，问题以英语、德语、法语、西班牙语、俄语和中文解决，保留所有六种语言中具有有效推理轨迹的问题，并通过模型重放这些轨迹以记录多层表示。对于每个模型，我们首先使用中心核对齐（CKA）识别具有跨语言对齐的层。在每个选定层，我们训练两个稀疏自编码器（SAE）：一个基线重建模型和本研究引入的对比变体，即几何不变稀疏自编码器（GI-SAE）。GI-SAE用信息噪声协同损失补充重建损失。
tldr: 本文提出几何不变稀疏自编码器（GI-SAE），通过对比学习增强重建损失，以揭示多语言大模型在跨语言数学推理中共享的几何不变特征，而非语言特定计算。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Geometry-Invariant Sparse Autoencoder (GI-SAE) that augments reconstruction loss with contrastive learning to uncover shared geometric-invariant features in cross-language mathematical reasoning of multilingual LLMs, rather than language-specific computations.
